verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Bruno's local-first privacy posture: it says it is offline-only, needs no account, has "zero visibility into your requests", and its BYOK AI does not route data through Bruno servers. None of the evidence documents a telemetry or usage-analytics setting, an opt-out control, or a statement that the app collects no usage tracking at all. That posture is an adjacent privacy claim about request data, not the opt-out capability the story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
